description: Decode up to 50 VINs per call with the official NHTSA vPIC database (make, model, year, trim, engine, drive, plant, safety equipment) and attach the open NHTSA recalls for each vehicle. Also look up recalls by year, make and model. Fleet recall monitor mode returns only recalls not seen before. An NHTSA outage is reported as unavailable, never as no recalls. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.003/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/vehicle-recalls-vin-decoder.

includeComplaints.description: If on, every vehicle gets an NHTSA owner complaints summary: count, crashes, fires, injuries, deaths, top 3 components and the 3 latest complaints. In Only new recalls mode it also returns one row when new complaints are filed.

includeFuelEconomy.description: If on, every vehicle gets its official EPA fuel economy from fueleconomy.gov: city, highway and combined MPG (MPGe for electric cars), fuel type, annual fuel cost in USD, CO2 grams per mile, EPA fuel economy and greenhouse scores and electr

includeRecalls.description: If on, every decoded VIN or vehicle gets its NHTSA recalls attached (recallCount and the recalls list). Turn off to get only the decoded specs. Always on in Only new recalls mode.

includeSafetyRatings.description: If on, every vehicle gets its NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings (overall, frontal, side, rollover stars and rollover risk) for up to 4 rated variants (cab, drive). Not every model is crash-tested; unrated models say so.

vehicles.description: Optional. Vehicles to check for recalls without a VIN, up to 20 per run. Each entry is a text like 2019 honda accord (year, one-word make, model) or an object {"year": 2019, "make": "land rover", "model": "range rover"} for makes with sever

vins.description: Vehicle identification numbers (17 characters, no letters I, O, Q), up to 50 per run. A malformed VIN returns a row with status invalid_format and is not sent upstream. VINs of US market vehicles decode best.
